random_forest.description: Ensemble of decorrelated decision trees using bagging and feature subspace sampling for high accuracy and robustness.

decision_tree.description: Non-parametric hierarchical decision tree that creates orthogonal decision boundaries based on feature entropy.

knn.description: Distance-based instance learner that classifies points based on majority voting of standardized nearest neighbors.

naive_bayes.description: Probabilistic model assuming conditionally independent Gaussian distributions per feature given the crop class.

svm.description: Kernel-based maximum margin classifier projecting standardized features into high-dimensional Hilbert space.
